howto.name: Upload your PDF
howto.text: Drop a PDF up to 500 MB.

howto.name: Specify pages to keep
howto.text: Comma-separated list and/or ranges, e.g. '1, 3-5, 10'. Only those pages will be in the output.

howto.name: Download the extract
howto.text: Click Extract. The output PDF contains only the specified pages in their original order.

faq.q: How is this different from Delete Pages?
faq.a: Extract keeps the listed pages; Delete removes them. They're complementary — use whichever produces less typing.

faq.q: Can I extract pages into separate files?
faq.a: For one-file-per-page splitting, use the Split PDF tool with 'individual' mode.
Bookmarks pointing to kept pages are preserved; those pointing to dropped pages are removed.
